name: Ore o Ijimeta Ano Onna (Otacir no Hime) o Wakarase ~Saimin Tsukaware Buzama Sarashite Ahegao Dogeza no Honki Shazai~
original_name: 俺をいじめたあの女(※オタサーの姫)をわからせ ～催眠使われ無様晒してアヘ顔土下座の本気謝罪～
source:
With a hypnosis app I hypnotized the Otaku princess who had tricked me
After getting her true feelings, I learnt that she is a scum who doesn't care about others.
If she want for her peaceful student life to be distrupted, I need her to reflect from the bottom of her heart...

[From DLSite]
translation:
我用催眠软件催眠了那个欺骗过自己的宅圈公主。
得知她的真实想法后，我发现，她是个完全不在乎别人的人渣。
如果她不想让平静的校园生活受到干扰，就得从心底认真反省……

[摘自DLsite]
